messages:
jamie-peopleops: Morning  We9re seeing duplicated interview invites and scorecards coming through from the ATS since ~08:14. Candidate folks are getting two calendar events and two scorecard rows.

Drew-recruiter: Confirmed. Candidates reporting "double invites"; some interviewers accepted both and are double-booked. Which webhook endpoint are we using for the scheduler?

luis-data: Pulled raw deliveries from our webhook receiver. Example payloads (two deliveries 42s apart):
```
{\n  \"event_id\": \"evt_YZ12\",\n  \"candidate_id\": \"cand_4512\",\n  \"type\": \"INTERVIEW_CREATED\",\n  \"timestamp\": \"2026-03-23T08:14:32Z\",\n  \"slot\": \"2026-03-30T09:00:00Z\"\n}
```
and
```
{\n  \"event_id\": \"evt_YZ12\",\n  \"candidate_id\": \"cand_4512\",\n  \"type\": \"INTERVIEW_CREATED\",\n  \"timestamp\": \"2026-03-23T08:15:14Z\",\n  \"slot\": \"2026-03-30T09:00:00Z\"\n}
```
They have identical event_id; ATS said it's their retry behavior.

jamie-peopleops: Key point: our webhook consumer currently processes every delivery and creates invites/scorecards without dedupe. We need idempotency on event_id.

dave-eng: Which service handles it? schedule-worker. I can add a dedupe layer keyed by event_id + consumer-id. Short term: keep ATS retry paused. Long term: store processed event_ids for X minutes.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: schedule-worker -> add-eventid-dedupe (PR #3490). Canary will roll 3 nodes.

sarah-talent: Ops ask: can People Ops run a remedial script to merge duplicate scorecards and cancel duplicate calendar events before the deploy? Interviewers are getting confused.

luis-data: I can run a dry-run dedupe and produce a CSV of duplicates. Command I used: `python tools/find_dup_events.py --window 120s --key event_id --output dup_preview.csv --dry-run`. Found 21 affected candidates, 39 duplicate invites.

Drew-recruiter: ATS support asked for a log snippet and the exact times we saw duplicates. I sent them the two payloads and the receiver timestamps. They've temporarily paused retries while we remediate.

anne-hiringmgr: Some interviewers already filled out two scorecards for the same candidate. How do we merge? Will merged scorecard preserve the earliest submission?

jamie-peopleops: Plan: People Ops will not accept manual merging for now. We'll run an automated merge that keeps the earliest completed scorecard and appends any comments from later duplicates into a notes field with attribution. Will communicate to interviewers not to submit duplicates.

Dave-eng: Implemented an in-memory LRU cache keyed by event_id with 10 minute TTL and fallback write to the schedule DB for longer dedupe. Pushed to staging, running canary now.

infra-bot: rollout update: canary 1/3 healthy, canary 2/3 pending. Monitoring: logs/schedule-worker + metrics/webhook.delivery.

luis-data: Ready to run the merge script. Script: `tools/merge_scorecards.py --by-event event_id --keep earliest --append-comments --confirm`. I'll run at 10:05 PST once @jamie-peopleops gives go. Will require calendar write scope to cancel duplicates.

jamie-peopleops: Go for merge at 10:05 PST. Remediation checklist posted to the #people-ops-runbooks channel. Quick external comms: notified interviewers to accept the earliest invite, do not duplicate scorecards, and we will merge duplicates centrally.

Drew-recruiter: Noted  ATS resumed sending but paused again after we asked. They want confirmation code/PR that added idempotency before they re-enable.

jamie-peopleops: After merge completed at 10:10 PST: 21 duplicate scorecards collapsed into 21 canonical records (kept the earliest submission), 39 calendar events reconciled, 6 interviewers notified with suggested swaps for conflicts. Closing incident TICKET-IT-4791 for now; will keep monitoring for 2 hours.

anne-hiringmgr: Thanks. Please send me the list of affected candidates so I can reach out where necessary.

jamie-peopleops: Shared the CSV to private channel and linked to ticket. Next steps: update vendor integration guide to require event_id and recommend exponential backoff / jitter on retries; add a note to interviewer training: "If you see duplicate invites at same time, pick the earliest and contact People Ops".

sarah-talent: I'll update the interviewer playbook and run a short sync with on-call interview coordinators later today.

jamie-peopleops: All done. If anyone sees further duplicate deliveries after 12:30 PST, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
